*You're right on the sand!*
Your DREAM Central Coast getaway awaits you at Strandcastle Beach House. This oceanfront home is directly on the sand! The home boasts magnificent views of the white sand, Oceano Dunes, and gorgeous blue Pacific Ocean from the floor-to-ceiling windows. The Strand is a special strip of homes right on the beach ~ the ONLY strip of homes on the beach where you can walk out the door onto the sand on the Central Coast. PLUS convenient Tesla L2 EV pay-per-use charging.

The space
The Strand is a very special strip of homes right on the beach and it is the ONLY strip of homes on the beach where you can walk out the door onto the sand on the entire Central Coast. Sunset bonfires are permitted on the beach (time for S'mores!) and you only have to walk out the door onto the sand to find your special spot. You will have the entire beach as your backyard playground. It's so stunning, it's ridiculous!

There is plenty of room for your families to sprawl out with 2 living rooms, multiple indoor/outdoor dining areas, a fabulous rooftop terrace, a gourmet kitchen, a wet bar, 4 bedrooms, and 3.5 baths. Every bed features luxurious new Purple Mattresses, and the Cal King is Tempurpedic. But that's not it, this home is also thoughtfully equipped with a Tesla charger! 
*Tesla L2 EV charging is available for $20 per vehicle, per night of use.*

Discover the laid-back allure of the Central Coast with a seamless blend of coastal delights. Wander along the shoreline to reach Pismo Beach, explore the scenic Oceano Dunes and nearby hiking trails, or simply soak up the beauty of the Central Coast. Whether you're renting recreational vehicles or bringing your own, the spirit of adventure awaits. Enjoy renowned dining, explore charming shops, and delve into local museums. A short drive opens up a world of experiences—from Avila Beach, Arroyo Grande Village, and the SLO Farmer's Market to the grandeur of Hearst Castle, vibrant car shows, lively festivals, wine tastings, Cal Poly, Morro Bay, Lopez Lake, and so much more! We extend a warm invitation to bask in the magic of our dreamy beach house and set the stage for what promises to be your BEST vacation ever!

MAIN FLOOR
 - 1 Queen bedroom w/ Purple Mattress and private en suite full bathroom
 - Powder Bathroom
 - Gourmet Kitchen
 - A living room that walks out to a beachfront patio PLUS separate living space with kids games, books, and more to keep the little ones occupied when you aren't at the beach!
 - Dining room adjoins Gourmet Kitchen and Living Room
 - Eat-in kitchen counter with seating
 - Laundry Room

SECOND FLOOR/ROOFTOP TERRACE
 - Private Primary Suite features a Cal King bed with Tempurpedic Mattress, 5-piece en suite bath and private balcony
 - Queen Bedroom with Purple Mattress
 - Queen Bedroom plus XL Twin Bunk Bed with Purple Mattresses
 - Spacious 2nd living room with wet bar, beach-facing balcony, and AMAZING views of the ocean
 - Rooftop Terrace offers 3 separate gathering/dining areas with a cozy fire table and breathtaking 360 views!
- Panoramic ocean views from the entire west side of the home and rooftop terrace ~ you really can't avoid seeing the beach!

Guest access
Guests have exclusive access to the entire property, including the beachfront patio, rooftop terrace, and attached 2-car garage with a pay-per-use Tesla L2 EV charger! Enjoy two living rooms, a gourmet kitchen, a laundry room, and Smart TVs. The home is equipped with top-of-the-line Purple Mattresses, a Tempurpedic Cal King bed, and Wi-Fi. No pets are allowed due to allergies.

Other things to note
Strandcastle Beach House 2.0, amidst the popular Oceano Dunes, offers a unique driving beach experience with easy access to 5 1/2 miles of shoreline. Enjoy a driving beach, off-roading in Oceano Dunes, surfing, walking/running, tons of outdoor activities, and proximity to dining, shopping, and medical facilities.

***DUE TO ALLERGIES, THIS HOME CANNOT HOST PETS***

For your safety and enjoyment, there is a contained Solo Stove with seating for 'easy clean-up' beach fires. Please note that a fine of $1,000 will be imposed for open bonfires within 60 feet of the home.

SOLO STOVE for your outdoor fire pit:
* The Solo Stove demands minimal maintenance, yet it is crucial for guests to adhere strictly to usage instructions.
* Please refrain from using water or metal utensils in the Solo Stove at any point.
* Allow the fire to naturally burn out until it transforms into ashes, ensuring easy disposal. 
*If it starts to rain or you think it may rain, please ensure Solo Stove is covered.:)

Indoor furniture, such as kitchen chairs, should not be moved outdoors; they are meant to remain inside the house.

For additional outdoor seating, please use the designated beach chairs conveniently located in the garage. *Please do not take the chairs down to the beach.*

QUIET HOURS:
We kindly request adherence to quiet hours from 9pm to 8am.

Avoid washing vehicles of any kind on the property or neighboring properties. Your cooperation is appreciated.

1208149007345202653.description:
Escape to our stylish Lompoc home, boasting hilltop views perfect for rocket launch viewing or reconnecting with your favorite people. Get your game on with a pool table, retro cocktail arcade game, PS5, 75" TV, darts, and table games, or unwind by the backyard fire pit. Walk to the nearby Bodger Trail trailhead, or enjoy a playground and open space across the street. Our newly remodeled home offers modern amenities, comfortable furnishings, and a warm, inviting ambiance. 
Pet-friendly: $50/pet

The space
Welcome to Fir Avenue: Game‑On Getaway, a newly remodeled four-bedroom, two-bath retreat tucked against the quiet hillside on Lompoc’s charming southwest side. Designed for comfort, play, and relaxation, this home is ideal for families, couples, or friends looking for a stylish place to unwind, and provides a clean and safe space for pets.

Inside, you’ll find a beautifully updated kitchen with a high-end stove, dishwasher, breakfast bar, and all the essentials to cook and gather with ease. The open living room features cozy new sofas and a smart TV with streaming subscriptions to Netflix, Disney+, and Paramount+, making it the perfect place to settle in for a movie night.

The converted garage offers even more entertainment with a dedicated game room. A large TV and preloaded PS5, pool table, and dart board make it a go-to spot for fun, while an extra refrigerator keeps your beverages cold. The home also includes a full laundry area with washer and dryer and exercise equipment for when you're feeling productive!

Step outside to enjoy a peaceful backyard setting complete with a firepit table and barbecue grill—propane is provided. There’s outdoor dining space for up to eight guests, making it easy to enjoy sunny afternoons or cool coastal evenings under the stars. In the front, a blooming rose garden welcomes you home.

The home offers driveway parking for two vehicles and additional free street parking. Located across the street from a neighborhood park and playground, and just a few blocks from the Lookout Point Trailhead, this getaway offers easy access to outdoor adventure while remaining close to all that Lompoc has to offer.

Book your stay and experience why Fir Avenue is more than just a place to sleep—it’s your personal getaway on California’s Central Coast.

Hosted by Space Coast Escapes! Pet fee due at booking applies per pet to ensure our home stays a safe and clean space for all guests. Optional services, such as early check-in and late check-out, may be purchased at any time through your guest portal, and paid for via the Airbnb Resolution Center.

Guest access
Guests have private access to the entire home, front and back yards, and garage with washer, dryer and game room. There's driveway parking for two cars and free street parking. Self-check-in via smart lock. The home is stocked with essentials to help you settle in and enjoy your stay. Landscaping service comes on Saturday or Sunday for an hour, hosts take the trash in and out from the back gate on Wednesdays and Thursdays.

Other things to note
Lompoc is the best vantage point on the West Coast for viewing the stellar rocket launches by NASA and SpaceX from Vandenberg Space Force Base. Missile launch days and times are released several days in advance and are subject to change based on weather conditions and/or mechanical challenges. Once booked, we'll provide you with all the details you need in your guest portal for checking launch schedules!

No RV parking in driveway or on the road.

Enjoy a peaceful couples getaway, or spend the weekend with the whole family at our house. The property is enclosed by trees for complete privacy, and features a large patio and a second story balcony. There is also a second driveway with room for an r.v. or two and a grill for a relaxing evening bbq.

There is also a 2000 square foot barn, tables, and chairs available for larger gatherings. Pricing based on size of the gathering and time of year.

The space
The master bedroom features a Cal-King bed, a large t.v. a large shower, and a jetted bathtub. Two of the bedrooms have their own bathrooms/showers and two bedrooms share a jack & Jill bathroom with a tub and shower. Upstairs there are 2 Cal-King beds, and 4 full sized beds, with an extra Queen air mattress available for larger groups. All 8 beds available have sheets blankets and comforters and all but one of the bedrooms have walk-in closets available. We have cable in addition to standard dvd/blue ray players, and of course Wi-fi is included.

We are located only 3.5 miles from the village of Arroyo Grande with lots of fun shops, restaurants, and wine-tasting rooms. Don't forget the Arroyo Grande Farmer's Market every Saturday from 12:00 noon to 2:30.
We are located 7 miles from 7 world-class wineries: Talley, Laetitia, Wolff, Tangent, Edna Valley, Chamisal, Tolosa, etc. 
We are located only 6 miles from Lopez Lake and 6 miles from Pismo Beach. Lopez Lake has water slides for the kids and fishing and of course boating.

Other things to note
We set check in at 3pm and checkout at 11am. We do our best to accommodate early check in and late checkout requests however. Landscapers tend to the yard on Thursdays, please do not ask them to leave the premises.

999845760970186485.description:
Welcome to The Narrows! A big, easygoing 5-bedroom Summerland beach house with a private jacuzzi, game room, two living rooms, and a separate bottom-floor studio — sleeping 8+, close to the sand. The Narrows solves the problem every group trip has: togetherness without the pile-up. Two full living rooms, a dedicated game room, outdoor spaces in every direction — and now the ace up its sleeve: a private studio on the bottom floor with its own kitchenette, bathroom, and laundry.

The space
Quick facts: 5 bedrooms (4 in the main house plus 1 lower-level studio), 5 beds, 3 bathrooms, sleeps 10, private hot tub (jacuzzi), game room, 2 living rooms, fully fenced backyard, BBQ area, washer and dryer in the studio, pets allowed, Located in Summerland, California, minutes from the beach, Montecito, and downtown Santa Barbara.

The top two levels hold four bedrooms and three bathrooms around a full kitchen, dining area, and two living rooms. Early risers, nappers, and the game-night crowd each get their own territory, then reconvene for dinner. Downstairs, the fifth bedroom is a private studio with a full kitchenette, its own bathroom, and a washer/dryer. It is a suite within the house that multi-generation trips fight over (politely). The fully fenced backyard wraps it all up, with the jacuzzi in the corner for the end-of-day debrief.

THE LOCATION. Summerland’s relaxed beach community, minutes from the sand, village cafés, Montecito, and downtown Santa Barbara.

GOOD TO KNOW. This home is part of Chosen’s Beach Collection: older, well-loved coastal homes with character, charm, and a few quirks that come with age and salt air. What they trade in modern polish they return in location, views, and value. The home has three living rooms, one on the first floor and two on the second. None of them can accommodate all guests individually. The home has a narrow layout and design, hence our name. The screen doors do not stay on but are available for guest use.

DISCLOSURES

* The fifth bedroom is a lower-level studio with its own private entrance and designated outdoor space. It has no shared interior living space with the main floors.
* This home has a charming beach shack feel and reflects the character of an older coastal property. While it is clean and well maintained, it does have a few quirks.
* The newer screen doors can occasionally come off their tracks if opened forcefully. Please use them gently.
* Some of the original window panes are older and may not operate as smoothly as newer windows.
* The large mature tree in the backyard naturally drops leaves and debris throughout the year despite regular maintenance.
* As an older coastal home, the exterior shell and certain finishes show their age, adding to the authentic charm and character of the property.
* For homes that allow pets, all pets must be added to the reservation with applicable fees paid during the reservation checkout process. If pets weren't added for any reason prior to checkout, pets must be approved and paid for prior to entry. This does not apply to service animals.

Guest access
Enter code and turn deadbolt away from door!

*Please be aware this home may not be suitable for elderly.

Other things to note
THE CHOSEN DIFFERENCE — WELLNESS BUILT INTO EVERY STAY

​​​​​​​Chosen is Santa Barbara's wellness vacation rental company, and every stay begins before you unpack. You'll be welcomed with a curated arrival gift of wellness essentials and local favorites, wrapped in a custom Chosen tote that's yours to take home. Every home is prepared with high thread-count linens, premium bath products, and non-toxic cleaning protocols.

Beyond the home, you'll enjoy exclusive discounts and complimentary access to Chosen's local wellness partners — hand-picked spa, massage, fitness, sauna, and recovery experiences across Santa Barbara, Summerland, and Montecito that other rentals simply can't offer. Want to go deeper? Personalize your stay with add-on services including in-home massage, facials, personal training, and private chef experiences, all seamlessly arranged by our concierge.

A stay like this isn't just booked — it's Chosen.
